text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I hear that many knights etched in legend 
received the blessings of spirits and 
gods—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
O statue of the Three Goddesses. Guide me 
and my master to ever greater heights!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
............Just kidding. Look at me, 
actually praying...
